p: Represents an abstract base class for managing scope-specific values in a layout node context. Provides methods for retrieving and setting values of a specific type.
Retrieves the value associated with the current layout node scope for the specified type.

ul.li: The value associated with the specified type within the layout node scope, or a default value if no value is set.

p: Sets the value associated with the current layout node scope for the specified type.

ul.li: value (T): The value to set within the layout node scope.
